quarterly_data.quarter: Cohere press release: Cohere to acquire AISLE to advance cyber-resilient (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Cohere announced a proposed agreement to acquire AISLE (founded in 2024; autonomous systems that discover and remediate previously unknown software vulnerabilities - more than 500 CVE-assigned vulnerabilities across more than 100 codebases in its first year out of stealth, per Cohere) and plans to launch Cohere Cyber, expanding its platform to help enterprises and governments secure AI systems; it follows Cohere's acquisitions of Reliant AI and Aleph Alpha. The transaction is proposed.
